options.description: This loop stays small: a session is asked only about what its branch changes, and a session in main is asked nothing. Refusing edits in main, with the exceptions landings and merges need, is captured as its own intent and designed separately. Recommended: keeps this change to one filter and avoids designing those exceptions here.
options.label: Separate loop for the refusal (Recommended)

options.description: This loop also blocks edits and writing commands in main's checkout, except landings, merges and plumb's own record commits. Bigger change; the exceptions have to be designed and tested in this loop.
options.label: Include the refusal here

payload.question: "No main work should be allowed": should this loop also make plumb refuse edits in main's checkout, or only follow from it (a session in main is asked nothing) and leave the refusal for its own loop?
